meta.name: Outlander: Sangre de mi sangre
meta.description: Es una serie precuela de "Outlander" que explora las historias de amor de los padres de Jamie y Claire. La serie se desarrolla en dos líneas temporales: la Escocia del siglo XVIII con los padres de Jamie, Ellen MacKenzie y Brian Fraser, y la Inglaterra de la Primera Guerra Mundial con los padres de Claire, Julia Moriston y Henry Beauchamp. La trama se centra en cómo estas parejas luchan por su amor en medio de obstáculos políticos y familiares, con elementos de viaje en el tiempo que conectan ambas historias.
meta.country: United States of America, United Kingdom

videos.title: Providence
videos.overview: At the Gathering, Brian Fraser and Ellen MacKenzie meet for the first time and are struck by their strong connection.

videos.title: S.W.A.K. (Sealed with a Kiss)
videos.overview: While Henry fights in WWI and Julia works in the censorship office in London, their love story unfolds through the letters they write to each other.

videos.title: School of the Moon
videos.overview: Ellen hatches a new plan to protect herself and her family. Julia is forced to make an impossible choice.

videos.title: A Soldier's Heart
videos.overview: Henry tackles a challenging assignment in his own way. Ellen learns some concerning information about the family into which she’s expected to marry.

videos.title: Needfire
videos.overview: Ellen and Brian attend Beltane. Henry struggles to hold onto his hope. Julia loses allies when secrets come out.

videos.title: Birthright
videos.overview: Henry continues to look for Julia until a new discovery threatens to end his search.

videos.title: Luceo Non Uro
videos.overview: Lord Lovat goes to extreme lengths to fulfill a prophecy. Dougal attends a clandestine meeting that could spell political disaster for the MacKenzies.

videos.title: A Virtuous Woman
videos.overview: At the request of the Grants, Ellen undergoes a test to prove her worthiness to marry into the clan.

videos.title: Braemar
videos.overview: All the highland clans attend the Earl of Mar's annual hunting event at Braemar Castle, where the Earl makes an inflammatory proclamation.

videos.title: Something Borrowed
videos.overview: Ellen prepares for her wedding day, while Julia attempts her escape.

videos.title: Remembrance Day
videos.overview: The fiery crosses have been lit across the Highlands. The call to arms brings friends and enemies home and the Jacobite Rebellion begins in earnest.

videos.title: The Veil of Time
videos.overview: Brian and Ellen help their clans prepare for the rebellion. Julia and Henry learn more about the stones at Craigh na Dun from unexpected sources.

videos.title: Rabbits Don't Swim
videos.overview: Julia welcomes a new member of staff to Leathers. Brian and Dougal train their men for battle. Ellen uses her wit to defend her family and her clan.

videos.title: A Portion of My Soul
videos.overview: Ellen and Grace ride across the Highlands in search of Brian and Dougal's forces.

videos.title: Forgive Me, Father
videos.overview: The Jacobite Army fights at the Battle of Sheriffmuir, while Ellen and Julia face their own dangers. Colum holds fast at Leoch but doubts his resolve.

videos.title: Small Mercies
videos.overview: Ellen finds herself a guest among unexpected company. Brian and Murtagh attempt a daring rescue. Henry makes an ally of a former enemy.

videos.title: Heart of the Highlands
videos.overview: Henry ventures off to procure gemstones. Julia finds a way to get back in Lovat's good graces. Brian returns to Leathers to settle a score.

videos.title: The Dance
videos.overview: Julia and Lovat attend an event honoring Loyalist Lairds who fought against the Jacobites. Ellen's plan to protect Leoch is put to the test.

videos.title: Outlander & Blood of My Blood: The Gathering
videos.overview: Outlander and Blood of My Blood: The Gathering unites cast members from both series for the first time to celebrate the Outlander journey, welcome in the new generation of Frasers, MacKenzies and Beauchamps, and explore the ties that bind their stories.
